title: Check the film festival submission title
goal: Check the title when the form is submitted and display the results on the same page.
summary: listens to the submit event of the form to handle this submission uniformly. First use event.preventDefault() to prevent the browser's default submission, then use trim() to remove the leading and trailing spaces of the title and check the length.
tasks: listens for submit on #submission-form. First prevent the default submission, then read the value of #work-title and remove the blanks at both ends.

Write feedback to #submission-feedback. After cleaning, "Please fill in the title of the work." is displayed when the title is empty. "Title requires at least 3 characters." is displayed when the title has 1 or 2 characters.
For titles with at least three characters, display “The title of the work \"Autumn Short Film\" has passed the inspection.” Replace the example title with the trimmed input.

example.note: After clicking submit, the delivery remarks form uses trim() to determine whether the user has filled in the actual content, and the result is left on the current page.

hint: also passes the check if you only fill in the blanks, make sure you use the cleaned title to judge the blanks and length. Both errors must display their own prompts.
